# Punjabi Folk Entertainment Ltd

> UK-based Punjabi wedding and event entertainment company led by founder and
> lead vocalist Reena Kaur, with over 25 years of live performance. Supplies
> Sangeet singers, Ladies Sangeet, dhol players, DJs and full concert line-ups
> for weddings, Sangeet and Mehndi nights, melas, festivals and private events.

## Services

- [Punjabi wedding entertainment](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/punjabi-wedding-entertainment/): the full wedding week — Ladies Sangeet and dholki, Mehndi, Jago, baraat and reception — covering which performers suit each event and the booking timeline.
- [Punjabi folk singers](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/punjabi-folk-singers.html): traditional Punjabi folk vocals for Sangeet ceremonies, weddings and receptions. Repertoire spans Punjabi folk, Pakistani classics, Bollywood and modern fusion.
- [Ladies Sangeet](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/ladies-sangeet.html): female singers and performers for women's celebrations, including interactive dholki-led performances.
- [Dhol players](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/dhol-players.html): live dhol for baraat entries, wedding receptions and dance sets.
- [DJ services](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/punjabi-dj.html): Punjabi, Bollywood and international sets with sound and lighting; MC services available.
- [Concert performances](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/concerts.html): full live line-ups for melas, festivals and community events at any scale.

## Booking facts

- **Pricing** is bespoke and quoted per event, based on the requirements discussed. There is no fixed price list.
- **Line-up size** is matched to the event. A team is specially chosen for each booking, with as many performers as the event needs.
- **Travel** is nationwide across the UK and international. Travel costs are factored into the quote up front, so the quoted figure is the payable figure.
- **Lead time**: booking at least 12 months ahead is recommended for weddings and major events. Last-minute enquiries are considered where availability allows.
- **Music**: set lists are built with the client. Custom song selections are standard.
- **To book**: submit the enquiry form at https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/contact.html or email info@punjabifolkentertainment.com. Quotes are issued per enquiry.

- [Sangeet, Mehndi and Jago explained](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/blog/sangeet-mehndi-jago-explained.html): what each pre-wedding night is for and which need live music.
- [How to plan entertainment for a Punjabi wedding](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/blog/punjabi-wedding-entertainment-guide.html): what to book for each event and when.
- [What a dhol player does at a wedding](https://punjabifolkentertainment.com/blog/dhol-player-wedding-guide.html): baraat, entrances, Jago, and how many players are needed.
